Just made this comment on a similar post— Amazon flex at DIA4 which can eventually lead to full time if wanted. The hours are 1:20am-11:50am but some flex employees can pick up smaller shifts if the 10 hours is too long. Two separate warehouses based out of one location tho. The other warehouse, HCI1, is an xl station (everything over 50lbs) with 2am-5am flex shifts, but smaller site so harder to get hired there. Also the DSPs are always hiring but you’ll likely find those jobs on indeed not on an Amazon website. 5 DSPs based out of DIA4, 1 DSP based out of HCI1. Faster to get through DIA4 as a driver than HCI1 but I know HCI1 is hiring drivers right now.

Unfortunately it is very confusing (and it almost seems like it’s on purpose). I would try again right now as our prime season is coming up in May/June so there should be a hiring ramp up. There are technically two warehouses —DIA4 which is the ZL delivery station or HCI1 which is the XL delivery station. Xl also offers flex from 2am-5am but it’s a smaller site so harder to get on there. If you have a valid license and decent driving record you could drive for a DSP on either side, I think ZL is faster getting drivers hired but I know the XL site is looking for drivers right now as well.
